bio.text: Amish Shah is the Democratic nominee for Arizona's 1st Congressional District in 2026, having won the July 21, 2026 primary.
He represented District 5 in the Arizona House of Representatives from January 2023 to February 2024.

Shah is a physician who was born in Chicago, earned a bachelor's degree and an M.D. from Northwestern University and a public health degree from the University of California, Berkeley, and, according to his campaign website, has spent more than two decades as an emergency room physician.
